extra.method: sequential memcpy for bandwidth; dependent pointer chase over a buffer larger than cache for latency

extra.link_speed_caveat: what the network card negotiated with whatever it is plugged into. It is not the speed of your internet connection, and it is not what this benchmark measured.

extra.iops_caveat: 4 KiB random reads against a file just written, so the page cache is warm; this measures the filesystem path, not a cold device

extra.declared_source: origin: GGUF header / HuggingFace model card; the node attests to what the model's publisher declared at origin, not that it is true
extra.probe_method: needle-in-haystack recall, walked upward from the smallest size: a unique token is planted at every depth of a prompt padded to fill the window (sized by the engine's own token count) and must come back from each. effective_ctx is the largest window that recalled at every depth; ctx_proved_tokens is the prompt the engine counted there; ctx_stop says why the walk ended.
